description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Arc], [MAG and MND +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Holy/Water abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Holy/Water abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (31.00 or 33.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on MAG and MND. Grants [Water, Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Holy, Water 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Holy, Water Buff Damage Boost (15s)] to all allies if user has at least element buff level 3 for Holy or Water, else [Buff Holy 40% (15s)], [Buff Water 40% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Water, Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Water or Holy attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Holy, Water 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Holy or Water ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Holy, Water Buff Damage Boost (15s)
description.text: Abilities deal 5/10/15/20/25/30% more damage at Holy or Water Elemental Buff Level 1/2/3/4/5/6

description.name: Buff Holy 40% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 40%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Water 40% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 40%, cumulable
